name: mezmo
description: Check Claude Code's Bash and MCP tool calls with Mezmo Governance, send Claude Code telemetry to Mezmo, and connect Claude to Mezmo MCP.

governance_access_key.title: Mezmo Governance access key
governance_access_key.description: Token of the service account that the Claude Code agent uses in Mezmo Governance, a standard Mezmo service key. Leave empty to keep governance off. With a key, every Bash and MCP tool call is checked before it runs.

governance_enabled.title: Check tool calls with Mezmo Governance
governance_enabled.description: Turn off to let tool calls run without a governance check. Governance from managed settings still applies.
